_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Neutral cluster pins score near Complacency band with no breaker fired; ±1 rung only and base-rate supports skilled HOLD inside the coil.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls Complacency/HOLD; narrative has no forward phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays range-bound with fear/greed ~45-55 and funding near flat
next_move.invalidated_if: Range breaks while ETF flows stay pinned near 0-1 and longs unwind from 99, or flows reverse and momentum lifts score into Disbelief
